items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The type scale and prose styles in one install. size-context brings the 6 roles, typeClass(), and the --fs-* / --lh-* tokens; the prose styles set rendered markdown and rich-text editors (Tiptap works as is) in those roles: wrap content in .typeset, and h1 is display in bold, h2 title, h3 to h6 subtitle, paragraphs body in the muted color, figcaption and code caption. Zero specificity inside @layer components, so any utility wins; .not-typeset opts a subtree out; spacing only above elements, so streamed content never reflows. Add .typeset-compact for the compact step.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Page reveals in 1 class, on the existing spring tiers: slow for landing, moderate for product. .reveal-landing for a page read once: the hero rises and scales in on load, later sections do on scroll, and every section leaves the same way at the top; .reveal-scroll makes a deeper element, like a grid card, a section of its own. .reveal-product for the app: blocks fade in on load, nothing on scroll. Each has a -subtle step. For slow data, .reveal-swap crossfades shadcn's Skeleton into the real block and .reveal-items brings rows in one by one. Pure CSS; reduced motion keeps the fades and drops the rest.

:is(.reveal-product, .reveal-product-sub.animation: reveal-skeleton-in 250ms ease-in-out 160ms both, reveal-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) 410ms infinite

:is(.reveal-landing, .reveal-landing-sub.animation-range: exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll)) exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll-start))

:is(.reveal-landing, .reveal-landing-sub.animation: reveal-preset 1ms linear both, reveal-leave 1ms linear both, reveal-preset var(--reveal-motion, 200ms linear(0, 0.5729, 0.8966, 0.9789, 0.996, 1, 1)) backwards
:is(.reveal-landing, .reveal-landing-sub.animation-range: entry var(--reveal-scroll-start) entry var(--reveal-scroll), exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll)) exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll-start)), normal

entry calc(var(--reveal-scroll-start) + var(--reveal-scroll) / 2) entry calc(var(--reveal-scroll) * 1.5), exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll) * 1.5) exit calc(100% - var(--reveal-scroll-start) - var(--reveal-scroll) / 2), normal

motion.source: <AnimatePresence>

<motion.div
                      key={`expanded-${idx}`}
                      className={`absolute ${shape.bg} bg-accent/20 dark:bg-accent/12 pointer-events-none`}
                      // Fade in from the item's current rect: with initial={false}
                      // a newly-opened item's background would pop in at full
                      // opacity mid-layout-shift while the previous item's bg is
                      // still fading out — reads as a glitch when switching items
                      // (especially under /demo's scaled card). Geometry still
                      // snaps (duration 0) so the bg hugs the animating item.
                      initial={{
                        top: rect.top,
                        left: rect.left,
                        width: rect.width,
                        height: rect.height,
                        opacity: 0,
                      }}
                      animate={{
                        top: rect.top,
                        left: rect.left,
                        width: rect.width,
                        height: rect.height,
                        opacity: isHoveringNonOpen ? 0.7 : 1,
                      }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: spring.moderate.exit }}
                      transition={{
                        top: { duration: 0 },
                        left: { duration: 0 },
                        width: { duration: 0 },
                        height: { duration: 0 },
                        opacity: { duration: 0.12 },
                      }}
                    />
<AnimatePresence>

<motion.div
                      className={`absolute ${shape.focusRing} pointer-events-none z-20 border border-[color:var(--focus-ring,#6B97FF)]`}
                      initial={false}
                      animate={{
                        left: focusRect.left - 2,
                        top: focusRect.top - 2,
                        width: focusRect.width + 4,
                        height: focusRect.height + 4,
                      }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: spring.fast.exit }}
                      transition={{
                        ...spring.fast,
                        opacity: { duration: 0.08 },
                      }}
                    />
<AnimatePresence>

<motion.div
                        className={`absolute inset-0 ${shape.bg} bg-accent/20 dark:bg-accent/12 pointer-events-none`}
                        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: spring.moderate.exit }}
                        transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}
                      />

<motion.span
            className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center"
            animate={{ rotate: isOpen ? 90 : 0 }}
            transition={spring.fast}
          >
<AnimatePresence>

<motion.div
              className={`absolute inset-0 ${shape.bg} bg-accent/20 dark:bg-accent/12 pointer-events-none`}
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              // The expanded tint rides the moderate tier, like the grouped
              // one — it marks a state, where the hover fill below tracks the
              // pointer and stays fast.
              exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: spring.moderate.exit }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}
            />
<AnimatePresence>

<motion.div
              className={`absolute inset-0 ${shape.bg} bg-hover pointer-events-none`}
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: spring.fast.exit }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.08 }}
            />

<motion.div
                ref={ref}
                className={cn("overflow-hidden", className)}
                initial={{ height: isOpen ? "auto" : 0 }}
                animate={{ height: isOpen ? contentHeight ?? 0 : 0, opacity: isOpen ? 1 : 0 }}
                // spring.fast lands with the trigger's chevron, and its
                // bounce: 0 keeps pure height from overshooting its content.
                // A close is a decision already made, so it takes the quicker
                // exit tier — the target flip has no `exit` prop to carry it.
                // Opacity runs ahead of the height on its own timing: the
                // body dissolves rather than being sliced by the clip edge,
                // which is what stops the rows below reading as shoved.
                transition={

export interface UseFluidHoverOptions {
  /**
   * With `nearest`, which direction to resolve the nearest item along.
   *   "y"  — vertical lists (default): closest by top/height
   *   "x"  — horizontal strips: closest by left/width
   *   "xy" — 2-D grids: closest card across both rows AND columns,
   *          measured by Euclidean distance to each item's center
   */
  axis?: "x" | "y" | "xy";
  /**
   * Makes an item invisible to hit-testing without unregistering it — for
   * rows that stay mounted while clipped away (a collapsed sub-tree).
   * Unregistering would invalidate every measurement; a skipped item keeps
   * the set stable. Consulted per mouse move, so keep it cheap.
   */
  isItemDisabled?: (element: HTMLElement) => boolean;
  /**
   * With `nearest`, whether a click that lands between items (a gap, the
   * padding, past the last row) is routed to the highlighted item, so what
   * is lit is what a click hits. On by default: in a menu or a list the
   * highlight is a promise about the click. Without `nearest` nothing is lit
   * between items, so there is nothing to route. Pass `false` where empty
   * space should stay
   * inert (rows with destructive actions, generous whitespace), or
   * `{ maxDistance }` to route only clicks within that many pixels of the
   * highlighted item's edge.
   */
  gapClick?: boolean | { maxDistance?: number };
  /**
   * Whether empty space lights the nearest item. Off by default: only the
   * item under the pointer lights, and the highlight fades out over empty
   * space (a popup's padding, the unfilled end of a grid row, a label beside
   * a control), gliding again from the next item it lands on. Pass `true` to
   * light the item nearest the pointer wherever it is in the container.
   */
  nearest?: boolean;
}

interface ElevatedProps extends ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"div"> {
  /**
   * Steps above the current substrate.
   *
   * The component's own surface level becomes `min(substrate + offset, 8)`
   * and is re-provided to descendants via SurfaceProvider, so further
   * nesting walks up the ladder automatically.
   *
   * Conventional offsets:
   *   2 — dropdown / popover / select menu
   *   4 — dialog / modal
   */
  offset: number;
  /**
   * Override for the shadow level. Defaults to the computed surface level.
   *
   * Pass a fixed value when the component should keep a constant shadow
   * weight regardless of how deeply it's nested — e.g. a dropdown always
   * reads `shadow-surface-3` whether it opens on the page or inside a
   * dialog, even though its background tracks the substrate.
   */
  shadowLevel?: number;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
